name: Theme
doc: Serves the active theme as CSS variables, and the Theme modality sets it by hand. A theme is a saved item of type theme; the most recently changed one is active, so saving or touching another theme swaps the look.

commands.name: default-theme
commands.doc: Make the default theme active again (saved as a new theme item)

modality.title: Theme
modality.doc: Colours and shapes of the app, set by hand
